items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He did a concert with Tommy Flanagan and Red Mitchell down in the Village.

ctx.x: That was a wonderful group. Tal Farlow was another story. I see in the paper he just came to New York again.
He did a concert with Tommy Flanagan and Red Mitchell down in the Village. He's sort of a semi recluse. He stays down at the Jersey shore.
